{{Quote|The attack was sudden and without warning. Several scuttling creatures overran our camp while large flying creatures dove at us from above. [...] One of the flying ones struck Yill'uop as she turned to run.|A travel journal entry|<ref name="10HSTG" />}}
'''Yill'uop''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="10HSTG">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Travel%20Guide|text=10 Hot Spots Travel Guide}}</ref> Yill'uop was part of a small scientific expedition,<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|32|Heitop}}</ref> including [[Mitsh]], [[Trenrel]], [[Heitop]] and [[Frann]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. When a storm hit the group's area northeast of [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]], Trenrel found a [[Giant Fynock Cave|cave]] where the group sought shelter. The group decided to investigate further into the cave and set up camp deep in the vast cavern. During their second day in the cave, the group was attacked by giant [[fynock]]s and Yill'uop was killed by one of the flying creatures as she turned to run.<ref name="10HSTG" />
